subject: Unexpected August Usage Spike — Request for Credit & VAT Evidence
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@aeroflow.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aeroflow Finance <billing@aeroflow.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden usage spike on 8/19 — can we get a credit?

Hi Karthik,

We noticed a large billing jump on 8/19 that looks like duplicate metering for our connector jobs. Our systems show a ~4x increase in token counts for that day and the August invoice reflects that. Can Redwood run a usage audit and issue a provisional credit while you investigate? We need VAT supporting docs for our reclaim.

I've attached our export (aeroflow-usage-export-202608.csv) and the billing line items in question (lines 23-27). Please advise next steps and estimated timeline — our accounting close is next Friday.

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Head of Finance, Aeroflow Inc.
[Attachment: aeroflow-usage-export-202608.csv (csv)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@aeroflow.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aeroflow Finance <billing@aeroflow.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden usage spike on 8/19 — can we get a credit?

Hi Tara — thanks for the heads up and the export. We're very sorry for the disruption.

Quick update: our ops team is already correlating ingestion logs and runtime traces for 8/18–8/20. Two immediate actions we can take today:
- Issue a provisional goodwill credit for the anomalous portion of 8/19 to avoid your close getting blocked.
- Run a deeper reconciliation and, if we confirm duplicate metering from our side, convert the provisional credit to a formal credit memo and reissue the invoice.

To proceed with the provisional credit, can you confirm:
1) Whether Aeroflow is VAT-registered in the US state you use for accounting (attach VAT/resale exemption if applicable).
2) Accounting contact name & AP email for where we should send the credit memo.

I'll loop in David from Finance to own the credit issuance and Marissa to assist with the VAT paperwork. Target timeline: provisional credit same day, formal credit + corrected invoice within 3 business days after investigation.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proforma-credit-note-INV-1127.pdf (pdf)]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Aeroflow Finance <billing@aeroflow.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@aeroflow.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Credit proposal and VAT evidence request (Provisional credit issued)

Hi Tara / Aeroflow AP —

We issued a provisional goodwill credit of $14,200 for the 8/19 anomalous usage. This shows as a pending credit on your billing portal under Adjustment INV-1127 (link below). We will finalize once our reconciliation completes.

Action items we need from you to finalize the credit and VAT handling:
- Please confirm the AP email for the final credit memo delivery (PDF).
- Provide VAT registration or tax residency doc if you want the credit memo to be issued with VAT specifics (we can apply reverse-charge where applicable). We included a sample VAT template in the attachment.

If you can send the VAT cert by EOD Monday we should be able to close this without impacting your August close.

Best,
David Kim
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vat-certification-aeroflow.pdf (pdf)]

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@aeroflow.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aeroflow Finance <billing@aeroflow.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit proposal and VAT evidence request (Provisional credit issued)

Hi David,

Thanks — we confirm AP contact is AP Team <ap@aeroflow.com>. Attaching our VAT certificate for finalization. We accept the provisional credit and would like the final credit memo to reference the original invoice INV-1127 and include a VAT reverse-charge note.

Please advise if you need anything else. We'll expect the corrected invoice and final credit memo before our close on Friday.

Regards,
Tara
[Attachment: vat-certification-aeroflow.pdf (pdf), aeroflow-accept-provisional.txt (text)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Finance Billing Queue <finance-billing@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL — Apply final credit and reissue invoice INV-1127 (Aeroflow)

Team — please apply the finalized credit of $14,200 to Aeroflow (Account: Aeroflow Inc., HubSpot ID 67890) and reissue INV-1127 with the following:
- Reference: Credit memo CM-2026-INV1127
- Tax treatment: Reverse-charge VAT note; include Aeroflow's VAT reg number from attached cert.
- GL routing: Use revenue code 4102 for credit adjustments; post to AR clearing code AR-ADJ.
- Send final credit memo PDF to ap@aeroflow.com and cc billing@aeroflow.com.

Attachments in thread include the usage export and the VAT cert. Please confirm when posted and update the HubSpot billing record.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Internal attachment: proforma-credit-note-INV-1127.pdf (pdf)]
